title: South Dakota Codified Laws Chapter 60-4 - Termination of Employment
verified_how: fetched https://sdlegislature.gov/api/Statutes/Statute/60-4: Type 'Chapter', CatchLine 'TERMINATION OF EMPLOYMENT', Repealed false, sections 60-4-1 to 60-4-12 (with 60-4-7 and 60-4-8 shown as 'Repealed' at section level). Confirmed on the Title 60 chapter index as row '04 Termination Of Employment' with no chapter-level [Repealed] marker. Currency: code effective date 2026-09-03.
notes: South Dakota is an at-will state and this chapter sets the grounds and mechanics of termination (sec. 60-4-4 'Termination at will', sec. 60-4-5 neglect or breach of duty, sec. 60-4-9 discharge for misconduct) rather than any severance-pay entitlement. There is no South Dakota severance-pay or mass-layoff-notice statute; collective redundancy notice is federal (WARN Act, 29 U.S.C. ch. 23).
